Lemonade Concentrate
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 5:29pm

Ingredients




cup sugar
cup water
9 whls lemons
sprigs of mint

Preparation

1 Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan; bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cool slightly. 2 Reserve one lemon to slice for garnish. Grate zest of two lemons; juice eight lemons. Combine juice and zest with warm syrup. Steep one hour. Strain. 3 To serve: Mix 1 part lemonade concentrate with 2 parts water. Serve over ice. Garnish with lemon slices and mint.
